final_message: No — none of the available tools (repo_read, repo_edit, repo_build, repo_find, repo_status, tests_run, tests_list, tests_focus, git_status, git_diff, git_commit, episodes_recall) can publish anything to a remote release system. They only operate locally: reading/editing files, running builds/tests, and committing to local Git history. There is no tool for pushing, deploying, or otherwise communicating with an external/remote system.
